notes: Address the user politely as तुम्ही, with polite imperatives (करा, निवडा). Buttons are short verb phrases (जतन करा, रद्द करा); headings and field labels are nouns. Devanagari has no capitals; use Western digits (0-9) and curly double quotes “ ”. Use the Devanagari loanwords Marathi app users expect for tech terms (साइन इन, लिंक (fem.), डिझाइन (neut.), PDF (fem.), फॉन्ट, अपलोड, रीलोड, ॲप) and native words for books and printing (छपाई, बांधणी, पुस्तिका, पृष्ठ, समास, प्रत). Failure toasts follow “X करता आले नाही — पुन्हा प्रयत्न करा”. Printer/OS setting names are given in Marathi with the English in parentheses, e.g. “लहान कड” (short edge); option names on Lulu's English-only website stay in English.
